record.paper_title: Open problems of the 32nd Workshop on Cycles and Colourings
record.original_question: For every graph G, is the list packing number χ⋆ℓ(G) at most Δ(G)+1, where Δ(G) is the maximum degree of G and χ⋆ℓ(G) is the least k such that every k-list-assignment of G admits k pairwise disjoint proper L-colorings?

evidence.quote: Problem 2.5 Is it true that χ⋆ ℓ(G)≤∆(G) + 1 for every graph G?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G=(V,E)$ be a finite simple graph. A *$k$-list-assignment* of $G$ is a function $L$ that assigns to every vertex $v\in V$ a set $L(v)$ of $k$ permissible colors. A *proper $L$-coloring* of $G$ is a map $c:V\to\bigcup_{v}L(v)$ such that $c(v)\in L(v)$ for every $v\in V$ and $c(u)\ne c(v)$ for every edge $uv\in E$. Two proper $L$-colorings $c_1,c_2$ are said to be *disjoint* if $c_1(v)\ne c_2(v)$ for every $v\in V$. The *list packing number* $\chi_\ell^\star(G)$ is the smallest integer $k$ such that, for every $k$-list-assignment $L$ of $G$, there exist $k$ pairwise disjoint proper $L$-colorings of $G$. Let $\Delta(G)$ denote the maximum degree of $G$.

Question: Is it true that $\chi_\ell^\star(G)\le \Delta(G)+1$ for every graph $G$?
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture that $\chi_\ell^\star(G)\le\Delta(G)+1$ for every graph $G$ appears to remain open in general. Recent work has verified the bound for graphs of small maximum degree and established an approximate (fractional) version, but the general statement and a Brooks-type refinement remain unresolved.

status_evidence.title: List packing number of bounded degree graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates whether every graph with maximum degree Δ has list packing number at most Δ+1; results highlight barriers to a Brooks'-type theorem for the list packing number.
status_evidence.claim: The bound is not yet established in general; only partial/approximate results are known.

status_evidence.title: Packing colourings in complete bipartite graphs and the inverse problem for correspondence packing
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses prospective upper bounds for list and correspondence packing numbers in terms of Δ(G), with a fractional relaxation showing the fractional list packing number is at most Δ(G)+1.
status_evidence.claim: Only the fractional relaxation of the Δ(G)+1 bound is currently established.
